protocol.selection_order: All scope exclusions by registry_order, then all exceptions by counselor_programme_id; resume by audit_population plus counselor_programme_id.
protocol.population_start: Current normalized data/registry/programmes.csv; upstream DUO/RIO population is out of scope.
protocol.confirmed_meaning: Supports only the facts and decision within audit_scope. For no-defensible-ucr-match, confirmation applies only to external-programme basis; UCR reassessment remains pending.
protocol.outdated_rule: Requires dated evidence establishing that the original decision was supportable and that a later change superseded it. Record temporal uncertainty explicitly when historical evidence cannot distinguish incorrect from outdated.
protocol.resolved_external_curriculum_action: Normally reassess-exception: an externally reconstructable comparator alone does not establish UCR feasibility.
protocol.reprocess_as_comparison_rule: Recommend only when comparison eligibility is independently established; do not infer it merely from resolved external evidence.
protocol.incomplete_batches: Keep pending cases explicit without audit_finding; never count pending cases as audited.
protocol.final_reconciliation: Every excluded target and every current exception must have exactly one completed audit entry per audit_population; report missing in-scope records separately.

reconciliation_evidence.exception_type_check: Read all 140 exception canonical JSON records directly; verified their IDs and recordStatus and inventoried exception.type only. This is population enumeration, not exception research.
reconciliation_evidence.comparison_count_basis: Current generated review index, with its complete ID set reconciled to both registry scope and canonical filenames; comparison contents were not audited.

cases.programme_display_name: German Language and Culture
cases.existing_substantive_exception_reason: German-language proficiency, German linguistics and literature, German-speaking-country immersion and Dutch–German cultural exchange form the core of this bachelor. UCR currently offers no German-language course or specialist German-studies sequence. Related courses in general literature, history, communication and European politics cannot form a credible 24-course closest-match programme without treating them as substitutes for missing German-language study.

cases.audit_basis: Current official pages support the defining German-language, linguistics, literature/culture, Dutch–German exchange and compulsory immersion basis. Confirmation applies to that external core only. The stored first/second-year labels (2026–2027) differ from the currently published indicative 2027–2028/2028–2029 pages. The current year-two page describes 30 EC free space with broader options, whereas component y2-minors restricts it to two Humanities minors. These source-context details need reassessment even though the external core is confirmed.
cases.recommended_fix: In a later authorized production task, determine the applicable academic/cohort year from the official education catalogue or programme regulations; refresh comparator.academicYear, sourceNotes, changed course labels and y2-minors. Describe 30 EC as free space if the applicable curriculum supports that. Retain the supported German core, preserve the indicative future-year caveat, and assess UCR feasibility independently in stage two. This audit does not edit the canonical exception.

provenance.existing_comparator_source_notes: Radboud presents 60 EC in each of three years. Year 1 contains twelve compulsory 5-EC courses; its two 0-EC academic support activities do not count toward the 180 EC. Year 2 contains three 5-EC required courses, a 15-EC German-speaking-country stay within the major, and 30 EC of minor space. Year 3 contains four 5-EC required courses, a 10-EC independent bachelor thesis/tutorial, and 30 EC of restricted minor space (two Humanities minors or the educational minor). The educational minor is an optional route, not a required qualification. Prospectus year pages are indicative and do not establish a guaranteed 2028–2029 year-three timetable for a Fall 2026 entrant.
